name: truegradient
description: TrueGradient AI plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: truegradient-forecast-plugin
plugins.description: TrueGradient Planning Analysis — nine skills that make Claude answer demand, supply and inventory questions from final, approved TrueGradient data only: forecast lookup with uncertainty intervals, accuracy and bias measurement, forecast-risk ranking, forecast-family change comparison, consensus versus TrueGradient forecast value add, disaggregation of top SKUs to series, components and warehouses, comparison of two runs of a planning pipeline, year-on-year comparison of actuals and forecasts, and supply/inventory analysis covering stock position, coverage, stockout timing, reorder plans and excess. Requires the TrueGradient connector, published in Claude's connector directory.
